user.title: Add a zeptrionAir device
user.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of the zApp device (for example zapp-12345678 or 192.168.1.50).

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the zApp WLAN device. A fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) is recommended.

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered zeptrionAir device
discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to add {name} ({model}) at {host}?

reconfigure.title: Change the device address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new hostname or IP address of this zApp device.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the zApp WLAN device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to a zeptrionAir device at this address.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device.
abort.not_zeptrion: The discovered device is not a zeptrionAir zApp device.
abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different zApp device.

cover.title: Cover settings
cover.description: Settings for {channel}. The device doesn't report positions; with position tracking enabled, the position is estimated from the travel times.

data_description.position_tracking: Show an estimated position and allow setting a position.
data_description.travel_time_up: Seconds from fully closed to fully open.
data_description.travel_time_down: Seconds from fully open to fully closed.
data_description.step_duration: Milliseconds a cover moves for the Step up / Step down buttons and the step action.

dimmer.title: Dimmer settings
dimmer.description: Settings for {channel}. Setting a brightness is experimental: the device can only dim for a given time.

data_description.dim_time: Milliseconds to dim from 0 % to 100 % (about 3400 for Feller dimmers).

abort.not_loaded: The device must be loaded to change its settings.
abort.nothing_to_configure: This device has no covers or dimmers to configure.

command_failed.message: The device did not accept the command: {error}

position_unknown.message: The current position is unknown. Open or close the cover fully first.

no_target.message: No zeptrionAir light or cover matches the selected targets.

entity_missing.message: The light or cover of this channel isn't loaded.

store_scene.name: Store scene
store_scene.description: Stores the current state of a light or cover on the zApp as scene 1-4, like holding a scene key on the wall. For blinds, Feller recommends driving fully up first, then to the wanted height, then storing.

recall_scene.name: Recall scene
recall_scene.description: Recalls scene 1-4 stored on the zApp for a light or cover.

move_step.name: Move cover a step
move_step.description: Moves a cover for a short time, e.g. to turn the slats of a blind.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Milliseconds to move (100-32000). Default: the cover's step duration option.

write_name.name: Write name to zApp
write_name.description: Writes a name and group (room) into the zApp, so the zeptrion app shows the same names. At most 32 bytes each; longer texts are cut.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name to write. Default: the name of the channel's device in Home Assistant.

group.name: Group
group.description: Group (room) to write. Default: the area of the device.
